purpose: Define the governed reduction lane for DEBT_GOV_LEXICON_UNDERCLASSIFICATION_001 without falsely declaring full canonical closure.

reduction_rule.statement: Lexicon debt is discharged in ordered passes. A pass may resolve the live governance blocker when active authority-facing and induction-facing terms are classified, even if the full historical lexicon backlog remains.
reduction_rule.non_equivalence_rule: Governance reduction does not imply global semantic completion of every historical lexicon entry.
reduction_rule.promotion_boundary: Terms lacking ontology_class or definition_mode after the active pass remain usable only under provisional or scaffold status and may not be cited as fully normalized canonical semantics.

passes.completion_rule: Each scoped term must declare ontology_class and definition_mode, or be explicitly marked as a scaffold with both fields populated.
Classify active induction scaffolds introduced after the governance-first freeze.
Reduce the residual bulk backlog without bypassing induction and claim gates.
Each scoped term has a bounded operational definition, an explicit provisional classification basis, an L0 evidence marker, and a retained non-promotion boundary.
